maddeler.e:
استوضحت (form X)
# اِسْتَوْضَحْتُ (istawḍaḥtu) /is.taw.dˤaħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# اِسْتَوْضَحْتَ (istawḍaḥta) /is.taw.dˤaħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# اِسْتَوْضَحْتِ (istawḍaḥti) /is.taw.dˤaħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# اِسْتَوْضَحَتْ (istawḍaḥat) /i
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
